question: Which due diligence questionnaire in the corpus asks the manager 'What kills a deal for your team?', and who published it?
gold_answer: The Private Markets Due Diligence Questionnaire ('Your Resource for Evaluating Private Market Partners') published by Calamos Investments with Aksia (file AC_Private_Markets). The question appears under General Questions > Investment Strategy and asks the manager to describe a recent example.
gold_passage: What kills a deal for your team?
notes: Document deliberately not named. grep -il 'kills a deal' over all 81 text files returns only this file. Publisher from the footer (Calamos Financial Services LLC / Aksia LLC copyrights).

question: Which due diligence questionnaire asks respondents what percentage of their current portfolio companies are located in New Jersey and what percentage are Life Science/Healthcare companies?
gold_answer: The NJEDA Appendix A Due Diligence Questionnaire (NJEDA Life Science Seed Fund notice of investment opportunity, 2023), question 4.6 under '4.0 Proposed Fund Investment Strategy'.
gold_passage: 4.6. Describe respondent’s proposal for how the Fund will invest the capital in NJ-based, Life Science/ Healthcare companies. What percentage of respondent’s current portfolio companies are located in NJ? What percentage of current portfolio companies are Life Science/ Healthcare companies?
notes: Document deliberately not named. The 'Life Science/ Healthcare' + NJ-percentage question appears only in the NJEDA file. Note that the text extraction of this file contains only Appendix A (pages 15-21).

question: In the SAA investment manager questionnaire for fixed income investment management services, which services is the firm asked to indicate whether it offers, along with any additional fee?
gold_answer: Five services: Schedule D investment accounting; asset/liability management (dynamic financial analysis); performance attribution; daily internet access of portfolio information; and SVO filing. For each, the firm marks Yes/No and gives an approximate fee.
gold_passage: Schedule D investment accounting Yes/No Asset/liability management (dynamic financial analysis) Yes/No Performance attribution Yes/No Daily internet access of portfolio information Yes/No SVO filing Yes/No
notes: Section IV Administration. Counted 5 rows in the Service / Service Offered? / Approximate Fee table. 'SVO filing' appears only in the SAA file.

question: Under the ILPA ESG Assessment Framework, how often does a GP review its ESG policy at the 'Intermediate' and at the 'Advanced' level of the 'Approach to Policy Review' component?
gold_answer: Intermediate: the GP reviews its ESG policy periodically, i.e. every 2-3 years, and can share recent findings and updates. Advanced: the GP reviews its ESG policy annually and can comment on its evolution.
gold_passage: Approach to No policy implemented; GP may reference plans to GP conducts a periodic review (i.e. GP reviews its ESG policy annually and can
notes: The PDF table columns are interleaved in the text extraction, so the passage is one extracted line with whitespace collapsed. The Intermediate cell continues on the next line: 'every 2-3 years) of its ESG policy and can share recent findings and updates'. 'reviews its ESG policy annually' appears only in this file.

question: According to the INREV Due Diligence Questionnaire for Non-Listed Real Estate Investment Vehicles, when was the questionnaire first launched and in which years was it updated?
gold_answer: It was first launched in April 2007 and updated in 2010, 2014 and most recently in 2018. The 2018 version introduced a phased approach with Preliminary, Advanced and Supplementary stages.
gold_passage: As the non-listed real estate market has evolved, the questionnaire has been regularly updated – in 2010, 2014 and most recently in 2018. In this latest iteration, a phased approach has been introduced.
notes: Launch date from the preceding sentence ('originally launched in April 2007'). '2010, 2014' appears only in this file. The INREV FoF 2022 DDQ also says 'most recently updated in 2018' for the main INREV DDQ but does not list 2010/2014. Possible near-duplicate distractor.

question: How many fund diligence topics does the ILPA Due Diligence Questionnaire v1.2 (2018) list in its Overview, and what is the last one?
gold_answer: 14 topics, numbered 1-14. The last is 14. Diversity and Inclusion, which was added in v1.2. The others are General Firm Information, General Fund Information, Investment Strategy, Investment Process, Team, Alignment of Interest, Market Environment, Fund Terms, Firm Governance/Risk/Compliance, ESG, Track Record, Accounting/Valuation/Reporting and Legal/Administration.
gold_passage: 6. Alignment of Interest 13. Legal/Administration 7. Market Environment 14. Diversity and Inclusion
notes: Counted the numbered list after 'The ILPA DDQ covers many topics related to fund diligence, including:' (two columns, 1-7 and 8-14). Also supported by 'Added Section 14 (Diversity and Inclusion)' under 'New in Version 1.2'. Pair partner DDQ-07 (2.0 = 20 topics).

question: How many fund diligence topics does the ILPA Due Diligence Questionnaire 2.0 (2021) list in its Overview, and what is the last one?
gold_answer: 20 topics, numbered 1-20. The last is 20. Diversity, Equity and Inclusion. New compared with v1.2 are topics such as Succession Planning / Key Persons, Co-Investments, GP-Led Secondaries / Continuation Funds, Credit Facilities, a separate Reporting topic, and Data Security / Technology / Third-Party(s). ESG is topic 19.
gold_passage: 10. Alignment of Interests 20. Diversity, Equity and Inclusion
notes: Counted the numbered list after 'The ILPA DDQ covers the following topics related to fund diligence:' (two columns, 1-10 and 11-20). Pair partner DDQ-06 (v1.2 = 14 topics).

question: In the 2021 version of ILPA's ESG Assessment Framework FAQ, how many resources are listed in answer to 'Where can I find additional resources pertaining to ESG?', and what are they?
gold_answer: 6 resources: ILPA's ESG Roadmap; ILPA's Diversity in Action Initiative; UNPRI's Private Equity Page; Sustainability Accounting Standards Board (SASB); Task Force on Climate Related Financial Disclosures (TCFD); The Institutional Investors Group on Climate Change (IIGCC).
gold_passage: ILPA’s ESG Roadmap • ILPA’s Diversity in Action Initiative • UNPRI's Private Equity Page • Sustainability Accounting Standards Board (SASB) • Task Force on Climate Related Financial Disclosures (TCFD) • The Institutional Investors Group on Climate Change (IIGCC)
notes: Counted 6 bullets. This file has no date. It is the original (2021) FAQ: the 2024 file states the Framework 'was first released in 2021 and most recently revised in September of 2024'. Pair partner DDQ-09 (2024 = 8 resources).

question: In the 2024 version of ILPA's ESG Assessment Framework FAQ, how many resources are listed in answer to 'Where can I find additional resources pertaining to ESG?', and what are they?
gold_answer: 8 resources: ILPA's ESG and Sustainable Investing Hub; ILPA's Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Hub; UNPRI's Private Equity Page; The ESG Data Convergence Initiative; The Private Markets Decarbonization Roadmap; IFRS's International Sustainability Standards Board (ISSB), noting SASB is now part of the IFRS Foundation; Task Force on Climate-Related Financial Disclosures, noting TCFD has disbanded after its 2023 status report; The Institutional Investors Group on Climate Change (IIGCC).
gold_passage: ILPA’s ESG and Sustainable Investing Hub • ILPA’s Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Hub • UNPRI's Private Equity Page • The ESG Data Convergence Initiative • The Private Markets Decarbonization Roadmap • IFRS’s International Sustainability Standards Board (ISSB)
notes: Counted 8 bullets. The passage covers the first 6 (300-char limit). The remaining two are TCFD (with a disbanded note) and IIGCC. File prefix 240901 = September 2024 revision. Pair partner DDQ-08 (2021 = 6). The rest of the two FAQ texts is nearly identical.

question: What topics does the ILPA DDQ 2.0 cover under its ESG section?
gold_answer: Section 19 (Environmental, Social and Governance, per PRI's Limited Partners Private Equity Responsible Investment DDQ) has six subsections: 19.1 Policy (ESG-related policies, governance and oversight, e.g. responsible investment policy, standards/frameworks, oversight and implementation responsibilities, ESG in compensation, staff training); 19.2 Fundraising (ESG commitments in fund documentation/LPA); 19.3 Pre-investment (ESG materiality analysis and due diligence, effect on investment selection, reporting to the decision-making body, deal documentation); 19.4 Post-investment (ESG value creation plans, portfolio company competence, board oversight, ESG KPIs, exit preparation, financial impact, sustainability outcomes); 19.5 Reporting and Disclosure (reporting ESG progress to LPs, LPAC/AGM coverage, material ESG incidents); 19.6 Climate Change (GHG emissions measurement and reporting, climate commitments/targets).
gold_passage: 19.0 Environmental, Social and Governance (per PRI’s Limited Partners Private Equity Responsible Investment DDQ) 19.1 Policy - Understanding your ESG-related policies, governance and oversight 19.1.1 [ISP 1, PE 1] Do you have a responsible investment policy?
notes: Subsection headings 19.1-19.6 are at roughly lines 2294-2521 of the text file. Distractors: ILPA v1.2 Section 10 ESG; the PRI covering note confirms the ESG DDQ is Section 19 of the ILPA DDQ.

question: What common areas do the due diligence questionnaires in the corpus cover?
gold_answer: Across the ILPA DDQ (v1.2 and 2.0), the INREV DDQ for non-listed real estate vehicles, the NJEDA Appendix A DDQ, the Calamos/Aksia Private Markets DDQ and the SAA fixed income manager questionnaire, the recurring areas are: (1) general firm information, ownership and organization; (2) team/staff, key persons and succession; (3) investment strategy and investment process/decision-making; (4) fees, expenses and fund terms; (5) track record/performance; (6) reporting, accounting and valuation; (7) risk management, compliance, governance, legal/regulatory and litigation; (8) ESG/responsible investment, which appears in ILPA, INREV and NJEDA, and diversity & inclusion, which appears in ILPA and NJEDA. Operations/IT/business continuity and service providers also appear in ILPA 2.0, INREV and AC.
gold_passage: 1. Firm: General Information 11. Market Environment 2. Fund: General Information 12. Fund Terms 3. Succession Planning / Key Persons 13. Firm Governance / Risk / Compliance 4. Investment Strategy 14. Track Record
notes: Synthesis based on section headings: ILPA 2.0 topic list 1-20; ILPA v1.2 topics 1-14; INREV TOC (Vehicle Strategy, Principal Terms, Investment and Asset Management Process, Vehicle Staff, Fees and Expenses, Track Record, Reporting and Valuation, Risk Management and Compliance, IT/Cyber, Corporate Governance, ESG); NJEDA sections 1.0-11.0; AC headings (Firm & Platform, Investment Strategy, Investment Risk, Valuation, Fees, Governance, Operations & Liquidity, Red Flag Questions); SAA sections I-VI. Passage taken from ILPA 2.0 only. Grade on coverage of the main shared areas, not exact wording.

question: Which bucket (Not Present, Developing, Intermediate or Advanced) did ILPA assign to KKR under the ILPA ESG Assessment Framework, and what numerical score did KKR receive?
notes: Plausible trap: KKR appears in the corpus only as a PRI working-group participant (PRI covering note), as a holding in an SBCERS custody RFP and as a manager name in TRS Illinois FY23. grep -i kkr confirms there is no assessment. The FAQs also say ILPA 'has intentionally forgone assigning a set of numerical scores', so no GP is scored anywhere. A correct response says this is not available or not done.

question: Which venture capital manager did NJEDA select to run its Life Science Seed Fund, and how much capital did NJEDA commit to it?
notes: The NJEDA file contains only Appendix A (the DDQ questions, pages 15-21). It has no dollar figures (grep -c '$' = 0) and no award or selection. grep -il 'seed fund' and 'NJEDA' over the other 80 files return nothing, so the selected manager and commitment amount are not in the corpus.

question: How many general partners had adopted the ILPA DDQ 2.0 by 2024?
notes: grep for 'adopt' across ILPA and PRI files gives only general statements (e.g. 'not intended to be a required document that all GPs must adopt', 'as the industry adopts the DDQ 2.0'). There is no count of adopting GPs. The 2024 ESG FAQ is the only 2024 ILPA document and does not mention DDQ adoption numbers.
